from datetime import timedelta

# dedup first
AA=AA.drop_duplicates('flight_id'); AS=AS.drop_duplicates('flight_id')
AA['sched_local']=pd.to_datetime(AA.date+' '+AA.sched_dep)
AA['actual_local']=pd.to_datetime(AA.date+' '+AA.actual_dep, errors='coerce')
AA['local_date']=AA.sched_local.dt.date
AA['delay_min']=(AA.actual_local-AA.sched_local).dt.total_seconds()/60
AS['sched_utc']=pd.to_datetime(AS.date_utc+' '+AS.sched_dep_utc)
AS['actual_utc']=pd.to_datetime(AS.date_utc+' '+AS.actual_dep_utc,errors='coerce')
AS['offset']=AS.origin.map(ap.utc_offset_hours)
AS['sched_local']=AS.sched_utc+pd.to_timedelta(AS.offset,unit='h')
AS['actual_local']=AS.actual_utc+pd.to_timedelta(AS.offset,unit='h')
AS['local_date']=AS.sched_local.dt.date
AS['delay_min']=(AS.actual_local-AS.sched_local).dt.total_seconds()/60
for name,df in [('AA',AA),('AS',AS)]:
 sub=df[(df.local_date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01').date())&(df.local_date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28').date())]
 completed=sub[~sub.cancelled & sub.actual_local.notna()]
 delayed=completed[completed.delay_min>15]
 print(name,'all window',len(sub),'cancel',sub.cancelled.sum(),'completed',len(completed),'delayed',len(delayed),'rate',len(delayed)/len(completed)*100)
 print('monthly',completed.assign(month=pd.to_datetime(completed.local_date).dt.month).groupby('month').size().to_dict(), delayed.assign(month=pd.to_datetime(delayed.local_date).dt.month).groupby('month').size().to_dict())
 print('missing actual noncancel',sub[(~sub.cancelled)&sub.actual_local.isna()][['flight_id','local_date']].to_string(index=False))
 print('examples rollover',sub[(sub.actual_local.dt.date!=sub.sched_local.dt.date)&sub.actual_local.notna()][['flight_id','sched_local','actual_local','delay_min']].head().to_string(index=False))

 d=pd.read_csv(f)

 print(f,'raw min/max',raw.min(),raw.max(),'negative',sorted(raw[raw<0].unique())[:20], 'count',sum(raw<0)); print(x.loc[raw<0,['flight_id','date','sched_dep','actual_dep']].assign(raw=raw[raw<0]).to_string(index=False))

for carrier in ['UA','B6']:
 d=pd.read_csv('airlines/'+carrier+'.csv').drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()

 d=d[d.date.between('2025-01-01','2025-02-28')]
 d=d[~d.cancelled].copy()

 a=pd.to_datetime(d.date.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')+' '+d.actual_dep)

 print(carrier,'completed',len(d),'delayed',(d.delay>15).sum(),'rate',100*(d.delay>15).mean())
